projectDescription: A complete, byte-for-byte matching decompilation of Super Mario 64 for the Nintendo 64, enabling source-level study, modding, and porting of the classic 3D platformer.
keyFeatures: Full byte-for-byte decompilation matching original N64 ROM for US, JP, EU, Shindou, and iQue versions
Complete C source code for all game systems including Mario physics, object behaviors, camera, and audio
Behavior scripting system for defining enemy and object AI
Level scripting system with geo layout and display list support
Enhancement patch system for adding features like crash screens, FPS counters, and debug tools
Multi-version build system supporting gcc and IDO compilers
publicApiSurface: MarioState struct — full player state including position, velocity, action, and flags
Object struct — generic game object with behavior script support and collision hitboxes
BehaviorScript — bytecode language for defining object AI and state machines
LevelScript — bytecode language for loading and initializing game levels
GeoLayout — scene graph description language for rendering hierarchy
Surface struct — collision triangle with terrain type and normal vector
set_mario_action() — transition Mario to a new action state
spawn_object() — instantiate a game object from a behavior script
surface_collision functions — ray casting and floor/wall/ceiling detection
math_util — Vec3f/Mat4 math utilities for 3D transformations
Camera system — dynamic camera control with multiple modes
